pred_texts: Instruct: Take a large pan and add four tablespoons of olive oil.
Success: Step complete.
Instruct: Switch on the stove with the pan, at high heat.
Feedback: You're almost there! Just make sure the pan is centered on the stove.
Instruct: Meanwhile, get the tofu, around 350 grams, and cut it into small even cubes.
Feedback: Not yet, you still need to cut the tofu.
Instruct: Let the oil heat until it's shimmering first. You can test it with one tofu cube. It should sizzle gently when you add it to the pan.
Feedback: Not yet, let it heat up a bit more.
Instruct: Add the tofu gently to the pan. Let is cook for about 2 minutes, gently stirring to prevent burning. Then turn the heat to medium and cover the pan with a lid.
Success: Step complete.
Instruct: Grab a green bell pepper, wash it and chop the bell pepper into small pieces.
Success: Step complete.
Instruct: Check on the tofu and stir it once more. Make sure it doesn't stick to the bottom.
Success: Step complete.
Instruct: Now, grab two small shallots and cut it also into small pieces.
Success: Step complete.
Instruct: Add the cut shallot and the cut bell pepper to the pan.
Success: Step complete.
Instruct: Push the tofu to one side and then push the chopped vegetables into open space.
Success: Step complete.
Instruct: Let it cook uncovered until the bell pepper is soft. Stir occasionally. Cook for about three minutes.
Feedback: Now, let's stir the broccoli.
Feedback: Great job stirring! Now, let's check on the bell pepper.
Instruct: Now add five teaspoons of soy sauce to the tofu and veggies in the pan. Spread the soya sauce evenly through out the pan.
Success: Step complete.
Instruct: Stir to mix the soya sauce together with the tofu and veggies.
Feedback: Not yet, but you're close! You're stirring, but make sure to stir evenly to mix everything well.
Instruct: Now add one tablespoon of ketchup and salt if required after tasting.
Success: Step complete.
Instruct: Mix everything well and let it cook for another three and half minutes.
Success: Step complete.
Instruct: Turn off the heat and cover the pan with a lid.
